Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [Main] effect to play a Tamer card with [Sora Takenouchi] in its name, does the "return 1 red Digimon card from your trash to the hand" effect activate?

Effect: [Main] You may play 1 red Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less from your hand without paying the cost. Then, if you have a Tamer with [Sora Takenouchi] in its name, return 1 red Digimon card from your trash to the hand.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 [Biyomon] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
